mapper.select: select ri.id, ri.user_id, ri.agreement_id, ri.apartment_id, ri.room_id, ri.repair_content, ri.status, date_format(ri.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') create_time_str, ai.name apartment_name, ri2.room_number from repair_info ri left join apartment_info ai on ri.apartment_id = ai.id and ai.is_deleted = 0 left join room_info ri2 on ri.room_id = ri2.id and ri2.is_deleted = 0 where ri.is_deleted = 0 and ri.user_id = #{userId} order by ri.create_time desc
